name: Wakakoma Shuzo
about: Wakakoma Shuzo is a sake brewery in Oyaku, Oyama, in Tochigi. It was founded in 1860 and is described as the oldest sake brewery in Oyama. Its main brand is Wakakoma.
Listings describe hand brewing centred on the family, using local water. The brewery building also holds a gallery and a party room for events, and the brewery has been used as a film location.
